comments.message:
It provides a great service. My only concern is the UX of managing the JSON files. I found most of the tool very easy to learn without training. Deleting a JSON file was not one of those things. Finding that JSON file on my hard drive isn't one of those things. Another thing that might prove useful over time is not importing a style or variable if it already exists with identical values in the importing file. In my brief experiments I found it simply creates duplicate name/value pairs if you import the same variables/styles more than once. 

Don't get me wrong: it's a great tool already and it has saved us (and will continue to save us) a bunch of time. I'm just pointing out potential areas to invest in to make it even better.
